summary: Raiders HC Klint Kubiak named Cousins the Week 1 starter over No. 1 overall pick Fernando Mendoza, preferring the rookie develop behind a veteran rather than start Day 1. Cousins went 13-of-17 for 101 yards and a TD in the preseason finale that sealed the decision, versus Mendoza's 25-of-45 (55.6%), 240 yards, 1 TD, 2 INT "rookie lumps" showing.

Will open his rookie season as Kirk Cousins' backup rather than the presumptive Week 1 starter assumed at the start of camp — the first No. 1 overall QB since Baker Mayfield (2018) not to start Week 1. Supersedes the earlier-August note assuming Mendoza had the job locked up; no timeline given for when he'd take over.

Named the Falcons' Week 1 starter over Michael Penix Jr., who is still working back from his third ACL tear. HC Kevin Stefanski cited Tagovailoa "putting himself in position to go be the best version of himself" in the new system; Cooper Rush is the backup. Atlanta's sixth different Week 1 starting QB in six years.

Will be inactive for the Falcons' Week 1 opener as he continues rehabbing a third ACL tear — cleared for 11-on-11 work only in late August and didn't play in the third preseason game. Says he's "really close" but wants to be 100% before returning; Stefanski declined to define a role beyond Week 1.

Left as the only quarterback on Miami's roster after the Dolphins waived Cam Miller and UDFA Mark Gronowski and traded backup Quinn Ewers away in the same 24-hour stretch of roster cuts. New GM Jon-Eric Sullivan is rebuilding the QB room from scratch behind Willis and was reportedly working the waiver wire/free agency for depth immediately after.

Survived the Vikings' roster cuts (kept on the 53-man roster behind Kyler Murray), ending speculation of a trade or release, largely because his contract offered little cap savings if cut. But he lost the QB2 job to Carson Wentz after an underwhelming preseason, a step down from the presumed QB2 status implied by earlier-August coverage.

Titans waived Will Levis, who had been working with the third team through camp, fully closing the book on any QB competition and leaving Mitch Trubisky as Ward's only backup heading into his first full healthy offseason as starter.

Confirmed as Cleveland's Week 1 starter on the initial 53-man roster, with Shedeur Sanders as the top backup and rookie Taylen Green third string. Dillon Gabriel — last year's more buzzed-about rookie option — was the surprise casualty of the QB shuffle (see separate note), removing the clearest threat to Watson's job for at least four games.

Placed on IR (designated to return) with a back injury at final cuts, guaranteeing he'll miss at least Cleveland's first four games despite a strong preseason finale (12-of-15, 186 yards, 3 TD vs. New England). Was the more hyped rookie name entering camp; this removes him from Week 1 competition for the backup job behind Deshaun Watson.

Confirmed unquestioned Week 1 starter as the Saints finalized their 53-man roster keeping all three QBs (Shough, Spencer Rattler, and offseason addition Zach Wilson), with Wilson and Rattler still actively competing for the backup job behind him.

Texans placed WR Tank Dell on IR (designated to return) on Aug. 31 for lingering effects of his 2024 multi-ligament knee injury, ruling him out through at least Week 4 — compounding the season-ending ACL tear WR Jayden Higgins suffered in camp. Stroud enters the season leaning on Nico Collins and a thin Jaylin Noel-led WR2/3 group.

Named the Colts' Week 1 backup quarterback (QB2 over Riley Leonard, who is QB3) after an offseason trade request that never materialized into a deal. Richardson has since walked the request back, saying he's happy to stay in Indianapolis: "if that's what the team wants, that's what I want."

On track to start the Colts' Week 1 game against Baltimore on Sept. 13, with the QB2/QB3 order behind him now settled (Anthony Richardson over Riley Leonard) after the full offseason competition played out in camp.

"All signs" continue to point to Mahomes starting Week 1 vs. Denver on Sept. 14, having "cleared every hurdle" in his ACL/LCL rehab and not missed a practice since being cleared for full activity in late July — though as of this report HC Andy Reid still had not formally named him the starter.

Voted one of six Jets team captains for 2026 by his teammates, a locker-room confidence signal as he takes over as the clear starter following the offseason trade that sent Justin Fields to Kansas City. HC Aaron Glenn has said he has "no doubt" Smith is New York's guy.

Confirmed as Giants starter for a primetime Week 1 assignment vs. Dallas (Sunday Night Football) under new HC John Harbaugh despite minimal live preseason reps — he played only two series all preseason before Harbaugh shut him down. Dart says practice reps against Dennard Wilson's defense have him feeling "in command" regardless.
